children.text: What constitutes a well-rounded education? The answer to this question is an ever-evolving one. In Our country, any education with science, technology, engineering, and math as subjects has been seen as a career-ready degree. But now everyone started to realize the importance of creativity and imagination. The new age courses are more focused on students’ passion. These liberal arts will help an individual to participate in active civic life. Let’s take a look at new-age courses that will help you build a great career without sacrificing your passion.

Animation: A career in animation is relatively new as compared to other traditional careers in the Service or manufacturing sectors. Animation is now widely used in the entertainment industry. It is a combination of art and technology, wherein you can design a film to impress, entertain and educate the viewers. Those with drawing skills and creative thinking can build a great career in the animation industry. The application of this art form is varied and its scope is truly unlimited. There are many animation colleges offering courses on 2D and 3D animations.

Performing arts: Performing arts are no new-age courses and have a rich history. Performing arts range from vocal and instrumental music, dance, and theater to pantomime, sung verse, and beyond. These arts reflect human creativity and cultural expression. Though these arts are not new and have a history as old as human civilization itself, interesting career opportunities are increasing now. Artists’ impact on society can never be measured.

Golf coaching: With the rising income level of the middle-income groups, growing purchasing power, rising middle-class populace, and greater participation in sports by youth, golf as a sport has developed remarkably in our country in the last couple of years. Golf on a global level is a very popular game but in our country golf industry is at the development stage and it has a scarcity of professional golf trainers. There are programs that offer all individuals who are desirous of becoming teaching professionals the opportunity to attend training programs to learn how to teach the game of golf.

Fashion Designing: Fashion design is the applied art devoted to the designing of clothing and lifestyle accessories. Fashion designing is one of the most lucrative, appealing, glamorous, and exciting career options in today’s world. If you have a penchant for creativity, style, and originality, a career in fashion design is the one tailor-made for you. There are many colleges offering courses in fashion design. The fashion industry in our country is ever growing and there is unlimited scope.

Film making: Well, who doesn’t like films? There are many people who are enthusiastic about filmmaking but are not ready to take risks. A career in the film industry is lucrative and attractive. There is no better way than learning filmmaking techniques and story writing from seasoned film and television professionals. There are many film institutes, that will help you get a hands-on experience in filmmaking, story writing, and acting.

Foreign language courses: Knowledge of one or more foreign languages can be useful in a wide range of careers. For some jobs, such as translating, interpreting, and language teaching, language skills are one of the main requirements. And also with local companies emerging as global players and our market being eyed by multinational companies, it becomes essential that there is no dearth of professionals who can overcome language barriers and facilitate smooth communication for proper business transactions.
